profile.name: m6000-base
profile.title: Quadro M6000 24 GB (Maxwell, sm_52): what every RAM size shares
profile.about: The engine switches below are the ones measured fastest on Maxwell (Q8 dense and MTP kernels, f32 dense, expert mode 8). The RAM-size profiles extend this one. Every profile also asks for a missed expert's slices together (STRATA_FETCH_WILLNEED, engine patch 0008) and sends the look-ahead's read hints for the top three ranks only (STRATA_LOOKAHEAD_K=3): with 32 GB that reads 60-77% less from the disk and, with its 128K context, makes balanced 7-8% faster; with 64 GB, where every expert stays in RAM, it changes nothing (within 0.6%), and when other programs push quality into reading from the disk it reads half as much at the same speed.
